body: Gurdeep Soni (Chairman & MD) on the Q2FY25 call (2024-11-08), volunteered: "this segment is likely to grow 25% to 30% year-on-year in this fiscal" Metric: Aftermarket segment revenue FY25 YoY. Target: +25-30%. Deadline: 2025-03-31 (fiscal-year). Specificity: range. Status as of 2026-11-19: PARTLY. Evidence: Delivered +20% (Q4FY25 call) vs 25-30% guided in Nov-2024 and repeated on 2025-02-07, 7 weeks before year-end. The shortfall was never called a miss; the 20% was presented as a success.
